payload.body: Two confirmations Conflab's re-cut needs from the cut's owner, ruled by vc, hold to them unless the code says otherwise: (1) DEVBIN_RELEASE_CONFIRMED keeps its name and its value, the tag, through WP02a and WP02b (D58: --yes answers the confirm and sets the variable the after: commands read); Conflab's .lib/brew:314 reads it. (2) release attach --from <dir> survives WP07 for object: local; WP07 adds the run keyed on the release commit's sha and removes nothing. Answer only if either cannot hold.
